issue.title: ONVIF PTZ: FOV translation space never advertised as profile default — Frigate autotracking disables with "FOV relative movement not supported"

findings.detail: Source uses submodules. Their availability and exact revisions need a separate dependency check. Resolved for this revision: The only submodule is docs/onvif-specs; the changed server sources, templates and focused tests do not import or build it.

resolution.reason: The only submodule is docs/onvif-specs; the changed server sources, templates and focused tests do not import or build it.
evidence: focused test and Linux server build compile the changed code without initializing that submodule

nextActions: Review the reported behavior and build instructions; define the baseline failure before cloning or scheduling a build.
limitations: READY_TO_INVESTIGATE means metadata is sufficient to begin engineering review, not a reproduced or repaired bug.
Dependency manifests are scanned heuristically; transitive dependencies, availability of registry packages, native libraries and physical equipment are not verified.
Only explicit PR references are matched; semantically related work without links can be missed.
Runtime compatibility, contribution policy and complete reproduction steps still require engineering review.

dimensions.reason: Frigate disables autotracking although the camera can execute the movement.
The owner filed the report yesterday against current source and Frigate 0.18.
The reporter owns the Jooan camera and supplied exact versions and code locations.
FOV URI appears as default only when both configured dimensions are positive.
The baseline lacks the placeholder in all five templates; the focused executable test fails before and passes after.
evidence: Baseline 8 failures plus 1 compile error; candidate 3 tests pass.

dimensions.reason: One selector and five template substitutions touch nine small files because the protocol repeats the PTZ configuration shape.
evidence: Production diff is 59 insertions/deletions across repeated render sites.

dimensions.reason: Focused tests are dependency-free; native Linux build compiles the ONVIF and notify servers, with only an unrelated existing WSD link failure.
evidence: 3 focused tests pass; onvif_simple_server ELF produced.

dimensions.reason: All PTZ profile/configuration responses change, but zero or incomplete FOV configuration preserves GenericSpace.
evidence: Four boundary assertions cover positive, zero and negative values.

dimensions.reason: Both firmware and ONVIF source were updated this week.
evidence: Firmware pushed 2026-09-13; source pinned by current firmware.

dimensions.reason: Every Thingino PTZ camera with real FOV geometry can become eligible for Frigate autotracking.
evidence: Shared response templates and standard ONVIF URI.

dimensions.reason: The selector is reused by media v1, media v2 and all PTZ configuration endpoints.
evidence: Fourteen rendering call sites share the helper.

dimensions.reason: One capability correction unlocks feature detection and subsequent FOV relative moves already implemented by the server.
evidence: Issue traces Frigate pt-r-fov gating and existing PTZ handler.
